name: Spatial Analogy Matrix Builder
objective: Deduce 2D and 3D transformation rules (rotation, inversion, scaling) to solve geometric analogies.
description: Interactive spatial grid where learners identify transformation steps between paired stimuli and extrapolate them to novel geometric targets.
instructions: Look at how Shape A changes into Shape B. Apply the identical transformation rule to Shape C to select the correct Shape D.
materials: Digital tablet/desktop screen or Printable Worksheet CFR-01.
progressionRule: Score >= 80% with average response time < 15s increases difficulty to next level.
regressionRule: Score < 60% provides step-by-step visual cue scaffolding and reduces difficulty level.

1.complexity: Single 90° rotation or single color inversion.

4.complexity: Isometric 3D rotations with hidden face deductions.

5.complexity: Topological transformations with nested continuous symmetries.

name: Numerical & Alphanumeric Pattern Architect
objective: Extract complex mathematical progressions, interleaved sequences, and algorithmic code systems.
description: Interactive sequence completion tool with arithmetic, geometric, Fibonacci, and multi-track alphanumeric streams.
instructions: Analyze the number or letter pattern. Determine the underlying rule to calculate the missing values.
materials: Interactive terminal interface or Printable Worksheet CSS-01.
progressionRule: Mastery at current level unlocks higher polynomial & cipher sequence tiers.
regressionRule: Two consecutive errors reveals interim step differences on a dynamic visual number line.

4.complexity: Alphanumeric coordinate matrices and Caesar ciphers.

name: Visual Silhouette & Closure Master
objective: Rapidly recognize obscured, fragmented, and rotated figures by mentally completing contours.
description: Timed visual recognition exercises featuring partial line drawings, hidden figures, and obscured contours.
instructions: Study the fragmented image outline. Rapidly identify the complete object or shape.
materials: Interactive canvas screen or Printable Silhouette Sheet CFU-01.
regressionRule: Failure to identify within 20s reveals +20% contour segments.

2.complexity: 60% complete geometric figures with angle breaks.

5.complexity: Interfering camouflage background with 20% contour visibility.

name: Visual Working Memory Constellation
objective: Strengthen visual working-memory capacity and spatial coordinate retention under timed exposure.
description: Memory matrix game presenting briefly flashed symbol configurations followed by delayed grid reproduction.
instructions: Memorize the positions and shapes shown on the grid before they vanish. Recreate the pattern on the empty grid.
materials: Interactive touch/mouse grid or Specialist Memory Flashcards.
progressionRule: Perfect recall increases grid dimension (from 3x3 to 4x4 to 5x5) and symbol count.
regressionRule: Grid dimension scales down with 1.5x longer exposure time.

2.complexity: 4 items with distinct colors on a 3x3 grid; 2.5-second exposure.

4.complexity: 6 items on a 4x4 grid with 3-second delay.

5.complexity: 7 items on a 5x5 grid with distractor interference task.

name: Visual Outlier & Rule Auditor
objective: Develop sharp visual discrimination to verify class boundaries and detect subtle rule violators.
description: Interactive anomaly hunter where learners inspect geometric arrays to find the single shape violating the group rule.
instructions: Determine the shared rule of the set and tap the one item that violates the criteria.
materials: Digital interactive view or Printable Anomaly Sheet EFC-01.
progressionRule: High accuracy unlocks multi-constraint rules (area + vertices + symmetry).

name: Verbal Analogy & Conceptual Bridge
objective: Master conceptual relationship hierarchies (cause-effect, tool-function, part-whole, degree).
description: Interactive verbal reasoning exercises linking semantic concepts across diverse academic domains.
instructions: Determine the relationship between Word A and Word B. Choose the word that completes the relationship for Word C.
materials: Interactive vocabulary interface or Printable Worksheet CMR-01.
progressionRule: Unlocks advanced disciplinary analogies (biochemistry, philosophy, literature).

name: Algebraic Balancing & Cipher Transformation
objective: Cultivate nimble symbolic transformations and mathematical problem-solving logic.
description: Interactive equation scale balancer, substitution cipher solver, and variable manipulation sandbox.
instructions: Balance the mathematical scales or solve for the unknown variables to satisfy all system conditions.
materials: Interactive scale simulator or Printable Worksheet NST-01.
progressionRule: Expands system from 1 variable to 2 and 3 simultaneous equations.
regressionRule: Step-by-step visual balance scale animation activates.

4.complexity: 3x3 simultaneous linear systems and matrix determinants.

5.complexity: Modular arithmetic equations and cryptarithmetic puzzles.

name: Inferential Reading & Logic Detective
objective: Deepen paragraph-level inferential reasoning, logical synthesis, and premise validation.
description: Short scenario analysis passages where learners evaluate evidentiary claims and deduce inescapable conclusions.
instructions: Read the evidentiary brief carefully. Select the logical conclusion that is strictly guaranteed by the facts provided.
materials: Interactive reading console or Printable Case File CMS-01.
progressionRule: Introduces complex multi-premise scientific and legal case scenarios.
regressionRule: Highlights relevant supporting sentence clues automatically upon error.

4.complexity: Multi-party debate synthesis & hidden assumption discovery.

5.complexity: Complex epistemological texts with subtle logical fallacies.
